newsitem.title: USA: PHLX, PSE to trade SuperGen options.
newsitem.headline: PHLX, PSE to trade SuperGen options.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange and Pacific Stock Exchange said Friday they would begin trading options on shares of SuperGen Inc on March 21.
The exchanges said the options would open with strike prices of 10, 12-1/2 and 15, with initial expirations in April, May, July and October.
Position limits of 4,500 contracts have been set.

At the PHLX, TFM Investment Group has been named specialist for SuperGen options and at the PSE, they have been allocated to lead market makers Guy Leung and Arvin Fong. ((Derivatives desk, 3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
